venues.name: Ford Wyoming Center

boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Credit card of purchase and Photo ID must be present when picking up will call tickets. Will Call is located at the main box office in the southwest corner of the Events Center.

venues.parkingDetail: Fourteen (14) (9 paved and 5 gravel) lighted parking lots can accommodate 3,600 vehicles. All lots are adjacent to the Ford Wyoming Center. Unless otherwise stated, the parking fee is already included in the event ticket fee.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Oak View Group strives to provide guests with disabilities the same opportunities to access the Ford Wyoming Center as others while allowing them to benefit from the same services. The Ford Wyoming Center is fully compliant with all ADA guidelines. Elevators and seating for people with mobility concerns are available. The Ford Wyoming Center offers wheelchair assistance to and from guest seats. Wheelchairs are not issued for the duration of an event. You may request wheelchair assistance from our drop off at the circle on West Boulevard, please call the SinclairTix Box Office at (307) 577-3030 in advance of your arrival. Assistive listening receivers, headphones and other devices are available to guests upon request at our First Aid station near the Box Office. A drivers license or state-issued ID is required.

Once a child has reached their second birthday they do need to have a valid event ticket. Please refer to the event information page for Age limits, as some productions have different children age policy requirements.

presales.description: To access the sale, use the first 6 digits of your eligible Citi® credit card or Citibank Debit Card as your presale code. You will also need to use your Citi® card to successfully complete your purchase.

presales.name: Citi® Cardmember Preferred Tickets
presales.description: To access the sale, use the first 6 digits of your eligible Citi® credit card or Citibank Debit Card as your presale code. You will also need to use your Citi® card to successfully complete your purchase.

events.info: Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron.. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs
events.pleaseNote: A warning to any fans with light sensitivity that strobing effects will be used during light shows within the Harlem Globetrotters game. By purchasing this ticket, you give permission to use your likeness.

events.name: Harlem Globetrotters Mvp Court Pass (check In By 6:30 Pm)
events.info: OPTIONAL UPSELL. NOT VALID FOR EVENT ADMISSION. MUST ALSO HAVE EVENT TICKET! FAN MUST BRING UPSELL TICKET TO EVENT DAY OF THEIR SHOW FOR COURT PASS ENTRY. NOTE SPECIFIC PRE-SHOW EXPERIENCE START TIME! COURT PASS TICKET REQUIRED FOR ENTRY.
events.pleaseNote: "THIS IS AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE. TICKET TO THE MAIN EVENT IS ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer than courtside with the MVP Court Pass! Join the Pre-Game Fan Tunnel to welcome the Harlem Globetrotters to the floor, step into the Pre-Game Huddle, warm up with the team, and watch the famous Globetrotters Magic Circle from just feet away. This is MVP access on another level, and the perfect way to make a memory you'll talk about for years to come. With just 16 passes per game, this is the most exclusive 20 minutes in the arena. Check in at the announcer's table 30 mins prior to the game start. Late arrivals will not be refunded. All participants must have their own MVP Court Pass - no exceptions. Children under 10 must be with an adult who also has an MVP Court Pass. Soft or rubber-soled shoes required. This premium upgrade is not included with your game ticket. Don't miss your chance to be part of the Rivalry as an MVP!"

events.name: Harlem Globetrotters Ultimate Fan Pass 5:30pm-6:00pm
events.info: OPTIONAL UPSELL. NOT VALID FOR EVENT ADMISSION. MUST ALSO HAVE EVENT TICKET! FAN MUST BRING UPSELL TICKET TO EVENT DAY OF THEIR SHOW FOR ULTIMATE FAN PASS ENTRY. NOTE SPECIFIC PRE-SHOW EXPERIENCE START TIME! ULTIMATE FAN PASS TICKET REQUIRED FOR ENTRY.
events.pleaseNote: "TICKET TO MAIN EVENT ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer to the action with the all-new Ultimate Fan Pass - a limited-capacity, 30-minute pregame on-court experience featuring the Harlem Globetrotters and their Rivals. Be first through the doors and first on the court, where you get exclusive access up close with the players, learn trick shots from the pros, get one-of-a-kind photos, and kick off your own tip-off party before the rest of the crowd arrives. Ultimate Fan Pass guests also get first access to the merchandise stands before the lines form. A separate game ticket is required and is not included with this experience. Minors must be accompanied by an adult who also holds an Ultimate Fan Pass. Soft- or rubber-soled shoes are required on court. The on-court experience begins 90 minutes before game time. Late arrivals may miss some or all of the experience and are not eligible for refunds."
